name: inkwell
description: Lets Claude look at what you're writing in Inkwell on your iPad, without screenshots.
long_description: Inkwell on your iPad saves page images to your own iCloud Drive (Settings > Share with Claude on my Mac). This extension reads them from your Mac so you can say 'look at what I just did in Inkwell' or 'check my Maths foundations folder'. Runs locally, no API key. When the iPad is on the same Wi-Fi it hands pages straight to this Mac, checked against a key kept in your iCloud.
